quotes.text: A Learned Transcendental preacher took for his text, “ Feed my lambs.” A plain farmer, who could not understand his discourse, quaintly remarked to him, on coming out of the church — A very good text, sir, was that; but you should take care not to put hay -so high in the rack, that lambs can’t reach it I ”
